name: Carabao Half Marathon (Carabao Marathon)
short_description: A half marathon event in Kota Batu, Jawa Timur, Indonesia, held on March 28, 2027, offering 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distances.
ai_summary: The Carabao Half Marathon, also known as the Carabao Marathon, is scheduled for March 28, 2027 in Kota Batu, Jawa Timur, Indonesia. Organized by the Carabao energy drink brand under Carabao Hydration, the event offers three distance options: 21.1km, 10km, and 5km. Registration is currently open for runners interested in participating.

faqs.question: When is the Carabao Half Marathon held?
faqs.answer: The Carabao Half Marathon, also called the Carabao Marathon, is scheduled to take place on March 28, 2027. The event will be held in Kota Batu, Jawa Timur, Indonesia, and registration is currently open for interested participants ahead of this date.

faqs.question: What distances can I run at the Carabao Marathon?
faqs.answer: Participants can choose from three distance categories at the Carabao Marathon: a 21.1km half marathon, a 10km race, and a 5km race. This range of options allows runners of varying experience levels and fitness goals to take part in the event.

faqs.question: Who organizes the Carabao Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: The Carabao Half Marathon is organized by Carabao, the energy drink brand, through its Carabao Hydration division. This brand-backed organization oversees the event, which takes place in Kota Batu, Jawa Timur, Indonesia, on March 28, 2027.
